items.what: Braelon Allen is questionable - latest (ESPN, Oct 28): Jets head coach Aaron Glenn said that Allen will be a limited participant in Wednesday's practice due to ankle injury, Zack Rosenblatt of The Athletic reports. Check his status

Ladd McConkey is questionable - latest (ESPN, Oct 28): Chargers head coach Jim Harbaugh said McConkey remains in concussion protocol but will practice Wednesday, Alex Insdorf of BoltBeat.com reports. Check his status

Jaylen Waddle is questionable - latest (ESPN, Oct 28): Waddle aggravated a previous chest injury during last week's 30-16 win over the Cardinals, and his status for Sunday's game against the Chiefs will be determined based on how he fares in practice this week, Ian Rapoport of NFL Network reports.
